page.title: Datel Wireless 'N' Networking Adapter For Xbox 360

revision.text:
{{Wireless adapter |brand=Datel |model=Wireless 'N' Networking Adapter For Xbox 360 |revision= |upc=854856002141 |ean= |asin=B003D3OOYY, B003UYTGGW;GB; |price= |est_release_date=01/15/2011 |fcc_date=12/03/2010 |manuf_country=United Kingdom |is_manuf=No |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type=Male A |form_factor=corded dongle |vendor_id=045e |device_id=02a8 |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=WLE-XA10009 |ic_id=9084A-XB1159 |chip1_brand=Atheros |chip1_model=AR7010;Atheros, AR7010-AL1A, A16764C, 1051, KOREA; |chip2_brand=Atheros |chip2_model=AR9280;Atheros, AR9280-AL1A, N3B624.00B, 1050, TAIWAN; |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |chip4_brand= |chip4_model= |addl_chips= |accessible_UART=Yes |flags= |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=abgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui=00:1D:D8 |lin_driver=none |win_driver=none }} "Ref2036" is etched onto the top layer of the board. :The board is using an AR7010-AL1A and an AR9280-AL1A. ::The AR7010 UART appears to be accessible via test points TP5 (Rx) and TP6 (Tx). There is an unknown [http://www.rawscience.co.uk/ '''Raw Science'''] (systems analysis and reverse engineering division of '''Datel''') IC on the board. It is labeled XB102.
[http://www.spinics.net/lists/linux-wireless/msg68737.html The device is not supported by ath9k_htc at this time (and may never be).]
